'''Teel wood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]]. The [[Azzameen family]] stored teel wood in [[Class-K cargo container|Class-K]] [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo]] [[Xizor cargo container|containers]] in their [[Azzameen cargo fields|secret cargo fields]].
